title: Supplied rational/common-stage Verdier pairing domains and lifted operations
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], the geometric Frobenius of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], the rational/common-stage tensor, partial internal Hom and pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and Weil pairs of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For a finite-type model $T_0$ and coefficient choice $E$ or $\Omega$, a supplied domain is a full subcategory of the recorded constructible category stable under actual geometric-Frobenius pullback; $C$ denotes this full category and $\Phi$ its restricted pullback. Tensor--Hom data are curried tensor and contravariant/covariant Hom functors with their Frobenius comparison isomorphisms. Their Weil lifts use the existing fixed-pair bifunctor lift, with inverse structure in the contravariant variable. Closed data additionally specify $K\otimes-\dashv\mathcal Hom(K,-)$, evaluation naturality in $K$, and compatibility of evaluation with the tensor and Hom Frobenius comparisons. A lifted adjunction specifies the underlying adjunction, left/right Frobenius comparisons and an adjunction of the resulting Weil lifts whose underlying unit and counit are exactly the original ones. Realization data identify the supplied tensor and Hom with restrictions of the recorded tensor and permitted-pair Hom; geometric pullback is pullback along the actual geometric fibre of the model morphism. For a supplied exceptional lift $F\dashv G$, ordinary lift $P\dashv Q$, and Weil object $W$, put $A=\mathcal Hom(FM,W)$ with the induced Hom structure and $V=M\otimes P(A)$ with the tensor structure. These are the definitions imageDual and tensorSource, respectively. These are data and constructions only, not assertions of equivariance of evaluation or of the three transposes.
